name: viewforge-3d-toolkit
description: Quality-gated multi-view 3D construction, biological skeleton animation, no-skin rigid binding, mesh refinement, and same-geometry appearance skills for people, animals, characters, products, and objects.

interface.shortDescription: Build, animate, rig, and refine traceable 3D models.
interface.longDescription: Build and audit multi-view 3D models for people, animals, characters, products, and general objects; create and animate bone-only biological armatures, rigid-bind segmented models without skin weights, refine bounded regions, validate topology and provenance, and apply appearance without moving accepted geometry.
defaultPrompt: Use $viewforge-3d-toolkit:viewforge-3d-router to choose the safe workflow for this 3D task.
Use $viewforge-3d-toolkit:build-biological-skeleton to build a bone-only Armature for a person or animal without weights.
Use $viewforge-3d-toolkit:animate-biological-skeleton to animate bones and rigid-bind segmented body parts without skin weights.
